subject: CareCorp: SSO session anchoring + service-account ownership evidence
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@carecorp.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: security@carecorp.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request — SSO session anchoring + service-account ownership

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG and SOC 2 intake we need a concise bundle focused on two items: session anchoring for SAML/SSO (how sessions are bound to identity + session timeout/renewal behavior), and an ownership map for all on-premise service accounts that can access customer scopes. Our auditor asked specifically for: 

- A diagram or short narrative that explains how Redwood prevents session fixation and how SAML assertions are validated end-to-end (including audience, InResponseTo handling, and clock skew policies).
- Evidence of session lifetime and re-auth rules (example logs or tracing showing session issuance and refresh).
- A CSV or matrix that lists every on-prem service account, the owner (name/email), the least-privilege justification, and whether the account uses scoped tokens or long-lived keys.
- Any redaction guidance you follow for on-prem artifacts before sharing with a third party.

Can you deliver a first pass by EOD Wednesday (our deadline with the auditor is Friday). If any pieces require an NDA/DocuSign addendum let me know.

Appreciate it — feel free to loop in the folks who operate on-prem infra.

Best,
Alice
Alice Wong
Information Security Manager, CareCorp
security@carecorp.com

--
Attachment: evidence_request_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@carecorp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SSO session anchoring + service-account ownership

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of what I'll provide in the bundle (will attach files):

1) A short diagram + narrative describing SAML session anchoring and our validation flow (audience checks, InResponseTo, cert rotation cadence, and how we handle clock skew).
2) Sample trace showing session issuance and refresh for a 30-min default session + an example of a forced re-auth at 24 hours (we'll redact PII).
3) A compiled ownership matrix for on-prem service accounts (owner email, justification, scope, creation date, rotation cadence).
4) Our internal redaction guidance for on-prem packs (what we remove vs. what we keep).

Attachments I will include in the drop: redwood_saml_session_diagram.png; scim-delta-sample-202611.csv; service-account-ownership-matrix.xlsx; redwood_onprem_sa_redaction_guidance.pdf.

Note: one tricky item — several legacy on-prem service accounts are managed by the infra team and have long-lived keys. We will flag those and provide a mitigation/exception explanation. Rishi is helping gather the infra owner confirmations.

We can deliver the initial package by Wednesday EOD PST. If CareCorp requires a DocuSign cover letter for the artifacts, we can sign that same day.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: redwood_saml_session_diagram.png (image/png); service-account-ownership-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Wong <alice.wong@carecorp.com>, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 07:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SSO session anchoring + service-account ownership

Markus / Alice — a couple of clarifications from the infra side before we hand off the CSV: 

- For on-prem service accounts that authenticate via an internal vault, we will provide the owner and the rotation cadence but will redact the vault path and any token IDs. Will that satisfy CareCorp's auditor?
- For service accounts used by batch inference jobs (tenant-scoped), do you want per-tenant access lists or a representative sample with the access model explained? We can do either but per-tenant extracts are heavy.
- We will mark accounts with long-lived keys as "exception: legacy" and include a mitigation note (rotations planned within 90 days).

If Alice confirms the redaction approach is acceptable I will start generating the ownership matrix and the sample traces.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Dec 15, 2026 at 10:14 AM markus_klein@redwood.com wrote:
> Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of what I'll provide in the bundle (...)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@carecorp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Final delivery: SSO/session + on‑prem SA ownership bundle (CareCorp)

Alice — attached is the initial evidence drop. High level notes: 

- redwood_saml_session_diagram.png: diagram + stepwise narrative covering assertion validation, InResponseTo checks, audience and recipient rules, and our cert rotation cadence.
- scim-delta-sample-202611.csv: anonymized SCIM delta export demonstrating provisioning events; column headers documented in the redaction guidance.
- service-account-ownership-matrix.xlsx: listing of 142 on-prem service accounts. Columns: account_id, platform, owner_name, owner_email, least_privilege_justification, token_type (vault-scoped | long-lived-key), rotation_cadence, legacy_exception (if present).
- redwood_onprem_sa_redaction_guidance.pdf: our redaction checklist — what we redact, what we preserve, and justification vs auditor expectations.

A few calls-to-action for CareCorp: 
- Please confirm the redaction approach (vault path/token IDs redacted) is acceptable to your auditor.
- If you need per-tenant detail for batch inference accounts, specify a list of tenants or we will provide a representative sample.

If you want a short walkthrough, Irene can run a 25-minute session to walk your auditor through the diagram and the matrix.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments included: redwood_saml_session_diagram.png; scim-delta-sample-202611.csv; service-account-ownership-matrix.xlsx; redwood_onprem_sa_redaction_guidance.pdf
